# Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rsample)

# Predictor names
raw_vars <- c(
  "B02", "B03", "B04", "B05", "B06",
  "B07", "B08", "B11", "B12"
)

vi_vars <- c(
  "NDVI", "GNDVI", "SAVI", "NDRE", "NDMI",
  "EVI", "BSI", "CIrededge", "MSI"
)

ilr_vars <- paste0("ILR", 1:8)

# Common complete-case dataset for fair predictor comparisons
data_ML <- final_data_ilr %>%
  mutate(.row_id = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    .row_id, year, Yield_avg,
    all_of(raw_vars),
    all_of(vi_vars),
    all_of(ilr_vars)
  ) %>%
  filter(year %in% 2019:2024) %>%
  drop_na()

# Development data: 2019–2023
development_common <- data_ML %>%
  filter(year %in% 2019:2023)

# Temporal validation: keep 2024 separate
validation_common <- data_ML %>%
  filter(year == 2024)

# Random 80/20 split, treating each year as a category
set.seed(123)
split_common <- initial_split(
  development_common %>%
    mutate(.year_stratum = factor(year)),
  prop = 0.80,
  strata = .year_stratum
)

train_pool <- training(split_common) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.year_stratum)

test_common <- testing(split_common) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.year_stratum)

# Create yield quartiles using training observations only.
# Tied yields may be assigned to adjacent groups.
train_pool <- train_pool %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(.yield_group = ntile(Yield_avg, 4)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Target training sample size
target_n <- min(5000L, nrow(train_pool))

# Proportional allocation across year × yield groups.
# Largest-remainder allocation ensures exactly target_n observations.
allocation <- train_pool %>%
  count(year, .yield_group, name = "available_n") %>%
  mutate(
    quota = target_n * available_n / sum(available_n),
    sample_n = as.integer(floor(quota)),
    remainder = quota - sample_n
  )

extra_n <- target_n - sum(allocation$sample_n)

allocation <- allocation %>%
  arrange(desc(remainder), year, .yield_group) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_n = sample_n + as.integer(row_number() <= extra_n)
  )

# Draw the shared stratified training sample
set.seed(456)
train_common <- train_pool %>%
  left_join(
    allocation %>% dplyr::select(year, .yield_group, sample_n),
    by = c("year", ".yield_group")
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, .yield_group) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ slice_sample(.x, n = .x$sample_n[[1]])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_n, -.yield_group) %>%
  arrange(.row_id)

# Raw Sentinel-2 bands
train_raw <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

test_raw <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

validation_raw <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(raw_vars))

# Vegetation indices
train_vi <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

test_vi <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

validation_vi <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(vi_vars))

# ILR spectral balances
train_ilr <- train_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

test_ilr <- test_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

validation_ilr <- validation_common %>%
  dplyr::select(Yield_avg, all_of(ilr_vars))

# Check sample sizes and year distributions
split_summary <- bind_rows(
  train_common %>% mutate(dataset = "Training (sampled)"),
  test_common %>% mutate(dataset = "Internal testing"),
  validation_common %>% mutate(dataset = "Validation (2024)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(
      dataset,
      levels = c(
        "Training (sampled)",
        "Internal testing",
        "Validation (2024)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  count(dataset, year, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(dataset, year)

print(split_summary)

# Check allocation by year and yield group
allocation %>%
  arrange(year, .yield_group) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, .yield_group, available_n, sample_n) %>%
  print()

# Confirm sample size and separation
stopifnot(
  nrow(train_common) == target_n,
  nrow(test_common) > 0,
  nrow(validation_common) > 0,
  all(train_common$year %in% 2019:2023),
  all(test_common$year %in% 2019:2023),
  all(validation_common$year == 2024),
  anyDuplicated(train_common$.row_id) == 0,
  length(intersect(
    train_common$.row_id, test_common$.row_id
  )) == 0,
  length(intersect(
    train_common$.row_id, validation_common$.row_id
  )) == 0,
  length(intersect(
    test_common$.row_id, validation_common$.row_id
  )) == 0
)
```



# Cross-validation
```{r}
set.seed(123)
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_ilr, v = 5)
cv_folds_vi <- vfold_cv(train_vi, v = 5)
```
